description: This file implements the AnalyticsImplementation class, including event handling, configuration, backend communication, and event mapping for an analytics system within the WPEFramework plugin. It manages event queuing, timestamping, and backend interactions.

classes.name: AnalyticsConfig
classes.description: Configuration container for analytics settings, including event map and backend library path.

classes.name: AnalyticsImplementation
classes.description: Main class managing event processing, configuration, backend communication, and event mapping for analytics.

classes.name: AnalyticsImplementation::EventMapper
classes.description: Handles mapping of event names based on configuration JSON.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Constructs and queues an event for sending, validating input and filling timestamps if needed.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Sets up the analytics system, loads configuration, initializes backends, and prepares system time.

methods.name: ActionLoop
methods.description: Main thread loop processing queued actions, handling time validation, event dispatch, and shutdown.

methods.name: IsSysTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if system time and timezone are valid for timestamping.

methods.name: SendEventToBackend
methods.description: Maps and sends an event to the configured backend.

methods.name: ParseEventsMapFile
methods.description: Reads and parses the event mapping JSON file.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimestampInMs
methods.description: Returns current system timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: ConvertUptimeToTimestampInMs
methods.description: Converts uptime in milliseconds to an absolute timestamp.

methods.name: EventMapper::FromString
methods.description: Parses JSON array string to populate event name mappings.

methods.name: EventMapper::MapEventNameIfNeeded
methods.description: Maps an event name based on configuration, trying various key combinations.
